problem_description: Compute the average of temperature, pressure and the potential energy of the 3D LJ fluid. Particles are arranged in a FCC lattice at a density of 0.8442 within a box of 10*10*10 (LJ unit). Velocities are assigned corresponding to a temperature of 3.0. The particles (4000) are interactine via Lennard-Jones potential with standard parameters (ε = 1, σ = 1) and a cutoff distance of 2.5σ. The system evolves in the microcanonical (NVE) ensemble. The simulation is run for 1000 timesteps
